example.title: Santa Cruz Municipal Wharf
example.place: Santa Cruz, Santa Cruz County, CA

brief: The long municipal wharf: a wide timber-planked deck on bents of creosoted timber piles with cross-bracing, a white-painted timber rail with benches, lamp posts, and a street of low restaurant and fish-market buildings along it; cars drive onto it. Four photos. The wharf dates from 1914 (much rebuilt since); no newer timber wharf of this length exists on the coast. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
